$comment: HAND-MAINTAINED. Every deviation from what fal's own OpenAPI document says — and nothing else.
This file is deliberately its own file, and deliberately almost empty. The generator's whole claim is that
the types come from the provider's published schema; an overlay is that claim being broken for a stated,
dated, sourced reason. Folded into curation.json or pricing.json an exception would read like an ordinary
row. Here it cannot: an entry in this file is a thing a reviewer has to justify.
Overlay kinds, each requiring `reason` + `source` + `verified`:
enumAdd              a value the endpoint accepts that the schema omits
enumRemove           a value the schema lists that the endpoint rejects
rangeOverride        a HARD bound the schema states wrongly (a request outside it is refused)
rangeSoft            a bound that is advisory — warn, never refuse
typeOverride         the declared type is wrong on the wire
denyParam            a declared parameter that must never be sent
shapeClass           force a shape class the classifier cannot infer
durationsAreSeconds  a bare `duration` number whose unit the schema does not state
note                 documentation only; changes no type and no check
ANTI-ROT: an overlay naming a parameter the schema no longer declares FAILS codegen. An exception that has
outlived the thing it excepted is worse than no exception — it is a claim about a wire that no longer exists.
Wave 1b still ships ZERO overlays, across all 54 curated endpoints. Two things the roster widening
might have needed one for turned out to be general LOWERING RULES rather than exceptions, and were
implemented in scripts/codegen-fal.ts instead — which is the right home for anything true of fal
generally rather than of one endpoint:
• the OPEN ENUM idiom (`anyOf: [{enum: [...]}, {type: "string"}]`, "these values or any other
string"), which flux-pro/v1.1-ultra spells for `aspect_ratio`. An unlisted value there warns
rather than erroring, because refusing it would reject a request fal accepts;
• MEDIA detection. fal documents a `ui.field` hint and emits one exactly once across these
snapshots, so the parameter's own name is the primary source (`image_url`, `mask_url`,
`audio_url`) and `ui.field` is the override. That rule has an escape hatch by design — a name
fal spells in a way the heuristic cannot see would be stated here, by hand.
The two exceptions the roster does contain are not overlays and do not belong here —
• `fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v2`'s real `model` wire field is recorded per-id in data/fal/curation.json
(`allowsModelProperty`), because it is a routing fact about the endpoint, not a correction to its schema;
• the unpriced endpoints are recorded in data/fal/pricing.json as `unpriced` reasons.
Both are statements the schema agrees with. Only a disagreement lands here.
